# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Overview
This report summarizes the financial records by region from the input dataset.

## Data Summary
- **Total Records Analyzed**: 18
- **Expected Records**: 24 (R001-R024 per README)
- **Missing Records**: 6 (R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021)

## Totals by Region

| Region | Amount (cents) |
|--------|----------------|
| North  | 290,988        |
| South  | 220,339        |
| West   | 282,339        |
| **Total** | **793,666** |

## Key Findings
The analysis was completed based on the 18 records present in the input file. The South region has the lowest total amount, while the North region has the highest total amount across the available records.

## Data Quality Note
The input CSV file contained only 18 of the 24 expected records. Six record IDs (R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021) were not found in the dataset. Totals reported above reflect only the records present in the source file.
